name: Anomalib Defect Inspection Archive
purpose: An inspection-line archive that stores every part image in Backblaze B2, scores it with Anomalib PatchCore, keeps the heatmap and score with the model version behind it, routes high scores to operator review, and retrains new model versions from adjudicated images read back from B2.
tagline: Keep every inspected image, heatmap and model version in Backblaze B2, and trace any part back to the evidence.

features.summary: store each part image in B2 and score it with Anomalib PatchCore

features.title: Review Queue
features.summary: operators record pass or fail on parts above the threshold

features.title: Retraining and Model Versions
features.summary: train a new model version from adjudicated images read from B2, stored with its metrics

features.title: Trace
features.summary: a part serial returns its image, heatmap, score, verdict and model version

features.title: Inspection Archive
features.summary: browse images, heatmaps, scores, labels and models by line and date

features.title: Lines
features.summary: create inspection lines and choose the active model version

features.summary: theme plus labelled demo preference fields

b2_surface.why: the browser uploads a captured part image straight to its line and date key
write heatmaps, Parquet score files, verdict labels, model checkpoints, metrics and training-set manifests

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Recharts
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, boto3, Pydantic v2, pyarrow, Pillow, Anomalib PatchCore (PyTorch, optional ML extra)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**), shown once at creation

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, when the bucket is public

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: separate-origin deploys only; Next.js inlines it at build time

env_vars.name: INSPECTION_DEVICE
env_vars.note: auto (default: CUDA, then Apple MPS, then CPU), cpu, cuda or mps

env_vars.name: INSPECTION_CACHE_DIR
env_vars.note: local cache Anomalib reads images from, filled from B2 (default services/api/.cache/inspection)

screenshots.caption: **Review Queue** — Parts scoring at or above threshold wait here, oldest first, with the captured image beside its anomaly heatmap and a pass or fail verdict form.

screenshots.alt: Lines page listing inspection lines and their active model versions
screenshots.caption: **Lines** — Every inspection line with its description, active model version and last update.

screenshots.alt: Line detail with part counts, score distribution and today's parts
screenshots.caption: **Line detail** — Per-line counts, the PatchCore score distribution, and the day's parts with status, score, threshold and model version.

screenshots.alt: Model versions table with activation controls and the train-new-version form
screenshots.caption: **Models** — PatchCore versions trained from images read back from B2, with AUROC and threshold, an activate control, and the form to train a new version.

screenshots.alt: Model version detail with configuration, metrics and the training-set manifest
